detail: The db is a gitignored derived cache (design D1), so the downgrade path is always: remove .twining/twining.db* and let startup ingest rebuild from the committed export tree. Mixed-version teams are unaffected across machines — only a version downgrade on one machine hits this.
summary: 1.22.0 migrates twining.db to schema v2 in place; a 1.21.0 client on the same clone then refuses to open it (user_version 2 > 1). Blast radius one machine — delete twining.db to rebuild from records/.
